summary: No concrete implementation blocker for one original first strict evaluation. Source, seal-interface and eight stdlib stub checks pass; runtime admission and strict success remain unverified.

checks.details: The two captured JSON records have identical state and exit objects. They record only prepare/m0/train, all exit 0, full training complete with 50 epochs, then stopped_before_mode=evaluate and supervisor exit 1. Both strict-artifact presence flags are false. The original controller guards storage before appending the next stage, matching the captured sequence. This verifies internal consistency of supplied record bytes, not the underlying remote training/history/checkpoint bytes.

Exactly one run_logged call is reached, with panel.command(original,RGBNT100,ambiguity,evaluate). The unchanged command retains original initializer, protocol, Signal source, CLIP and full output directory. Producer fixes seed 42/epochs 50 and dispatches evaluate to the inherited foundation evaluator. That evaluator strictly loads best_map.pth and recomputes the historical maximum only to assert the saved selection; it does not replace/reselect the checkpoint. Existing 1e-5 metric equality check is unchanged. No prepare, M0, training, optimizer, seed/gain/precision change or additional diagnostic is introduced by this controller.

The controller reads and deep-copies the original stopped campaign, records its original path/exit 1, writes only the new administrative campaign, retains all three stage objects, and appends evaluate. The deliberately identical campaign basename yields the identical trained-model path through existing output_dir. Existing reporter accepts the resulting four successful stages, reads the original run's metric/distance/training files, and asserts parsed receipt equals job.result plus checkpoint/distance hashes. It does not rewrite those result files. No reporter or output_dir override/fallback is added; line 51 retains the original controllers' source_map wiring. This has not run against real strict bytes. Previous five reports are outside this re-audit.

Entry checks schema/controller SHA, all source pins, all artifact pins, original terminal/stage state, full epoch sequence, strict-artifact absence and 2,684,354,560 free bytes. It records the provided seal SHA and rechecks artifact hashes after child success. Actual run_logged calls require_sources, whose manifest source and initializer hashes are checked, then a 2 GiB reserve and the original nvidia-smi 0,1 memory admission (<500 MiB each, 240-second wait); Popen forces CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1. The newly supplied seal is internally consistent: 463 pins equal the original seal and captured state; all original 50 artifact pins retained; exactly nine remaining stage/full inputs and two M0 text inputs added. The exact original seal digest is a documentary field in the new seal and is compared here; the unchanged reporter also checks state.input_seal_sha256 against live panel.SCOPE. The controller itself verifies panel.SCOPE's source map rather than directly comparing the documentary original_source_seal_sha256 field. No present mismatch or source correction is indicated. Actual live source/artifact/disk/device/host admission remains unverified.

Existing run_logged stores process.wait()'s exact exit code on the stage and removes active_command. Nonzero child status becomes FAILED and the new controller returns the same code. Exit 0 is written as STRICT_EXIT0_VALIDATION_PENDING before reading/asserting strict receipts or immutable hashes. Thus an ordinary post-child validation assertion retains child exit 0 and a nonaccepted pending state; it does not leave RUNNING or falsely mark COMPLETE. Stubs exercised success, child exit 17 and wrong-condition validation failure. Actual supervisor receipt has not been observed for this proposed run.

No deletion, checkpoint save, optimizer/training call, restoration, or diagnostic launch exists on this continuation path. The target original best is pinned and rechecked. Cleanup receipt records one closed historical H2a100 remote duplicate retired after local archive, current_best_deleted=0, 50 original protected artifacts and 14 extra SHA entries for six current bests/eight Signal bests. The target best pin agrees with terminal capture and new seal. Receipt records 3,019,280,384 free bytes; that is not current admission. This review did not rehash the historical binary/archive or remote protected files. The retired historical path needs explicit restoration before any future use; this controller does not use it.

No concrete implementation blocker found for the requested first-unattempted-evaluation-only scope. No source change, fallback, try/except, threshold relaxation or protocol expansion is requested. Existing deployment/publication, fresh runtime admissions, one child invocation with its real exit, strict artifact validation and later CPU report remain unperformed work, not outcomes established by this review.

warnings: Exact local requested source/plan/capture/seal bytes and selected inherited source bytes were read and hashed. Captured observations are not independent access to remote raw campaign/EXIT/history/steps/order/checkpoint bytes.

The proposed controller/seal have not been deployed, launched or admitted by this reviewer. No SSH, actual GPU query, production-module import, NN execution, package install or source/shared-memory mutation occurred.

No full re-audit of all 463 source bodies or the previous five results was performed. Thirteen Python files were AST-parsed; only the necessary inherited source sections were traced. Ten relevant sealed-source file hashes matched the captured 463-entry map.

Eight dynamic cases use synthetic memory-only files and stub subprocess/device behavior. They demonstrate control flow and error-state behavior only, not real seals, devices, initialization, numerical repeatability or strict success.

The historical H2a100 archive and current protected remote binaries were not independently rehashed by this reviewer; protection evidence is the supplied cleanup receipt and the absence of a destructive path in this continuation.
The existing endpoint CPU reporter remains contingent on actual four-stage success and matching original strict files. No six-endpoint acceptance or actual first-strict success is claimed.
Requested reviewer model gpt-6-astra and reasoning effort max are request metadata. Actual service model and effort are UNATTESTED; reviewer assurance is same-family/provisional.
claim_boundary: Source assurance only. No numerical/performance forecast, stronger-teacher/compression causality, all-six acceptance or successful strict-run claim.
